# SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.11 scientific-owner revision directive

Date: 2026-08-21

Owner: Grant Wilson

Status: Binding scientific-owner authority for a targeted r0.10-to-r0.11
implementation-blind scientific-authorship revision. The contract version
remains v0.1. This directive does not itself freeze r0.11.

Exact supplied directive SHA-256:
`89eb07832fa064238045c6c765c019f3b6fe74c3e5d1c6f163de5f5ebd20e9d8`.

Comparison baseline: sealed candidate commit
`326ec554998a124202d746f435bec8180e875fa1` (v0.1/r0.10).

## Reopening boundary

R0.11 is a paired-processing amendment, not merely an optional-output
addition. Accepted evidence originating in $r$ may change conditioned-$x$
masks, segments, affected support, and resolved plan selection. Therefore the
r0.10 preservation claim is narrowed: existing conditioned-$x$ fixed-stage
filter definitions, donor-factor direction, CAL ordering, phase-zero
definition, representative-occurrence identity, and learn--resolve--apply
lifecycle remain unchanged, while pair-level selection/support may change
under the decisions below.

No implementation, tests, schemas, configuration, audit or repair history,
production reductions, historical defaults, external literature, or web
content may supply authority. No numerical threshold or current algorithm may
be inferred.

## Closed decision R11-D01 -- Canonical identical paired operator

Every ordinary jointly applicable canonical RTC stage uses one identical
resolved temporal and sampling operator on $x$ and $r$. On common available
support the fixed-state response is
$J_{\rm pair,\Pi}=I_2\otimes L_\Pi$. Masks, pair-level action support,
segments, transitions, guards, coefficients, state, initialization/reset,
filter definitions, order/precision, phase/delay, boundaries, downsampling,
selected times, representative occurrences, cardinality, and output grid are
common. Both numerical cross-coordinate branches remain zero. A separately
optimized $r$ diagnostic, if later authorized, is a separately named
descendant and not the canonical companion.

## Closed decision R11-D02 -- Coordinate-specific and joint evidence

Learn may produce $E_x$, $E_r$, and genuinely joint $E_{xr}$. Each evidence
record preserves detector/sample identity, coordinate of origin, estimator,
support, source protection, Tune/mapping state, uncertainty, quality, causal
class, direct/inferred status, and source/frequency domain where relevant.
Evidence origin is never erased by later pair action.

## Closed decision R11-D03 -- Pair-level resolve and cause-preserving union

Resolve, not Apply, composes the evidence under owner-approved policy into one
pair plan. For owner-designated hard classes,
$B_{\rm pair}=B_x^{\rm hard}\cup B_r^{\rm hard}\cup B_{xr}^{\rm hard}$.
Apply uses the same resolved support for both coordinates. It neither
discovers a new event nor mutates the pair plan within an apply pass; new
evidence enters only through a successor learn--resolve--apply attempt. The
action support is unioned, not the evidence records or causes.

## Closed decision R11-D04 -- Hard pair events and direct/inferred causes

An accepted hard event in $x$, $r$, or joint evidence flags the paired
occurrence and declared support for both coordinates. Accepted spikes,
level shifts, resets/discontinuities, structurally invalid mapped pairs,
declared non-finite/out-of-domain events, and any later owner-approved hard
class may produce pair action under their selected policies. The record
distinguishes direct $x$, direct $r$, joint, inferred-$x$-from-$r$, and
inferred-$r$-from-$x$ causes. Inferred pair consequence is never rewritten as
direct detection in the other coordinate.

## Closed decision R11-D05 -- Three-layer validity and availability

RTC keeps separate: (1) coordinate-local raw numerical validity and direct
evidence; (2) the accepted pair event and unioned masks, guards, segments, and
reset boundaries; and (3) coordinate-local conditioned availability,
modification, and response availability. A valid payload does not erase a
pair event inferred from the other coordinate, and pair action does not assert
direct evidence in both.

## Closed decision R11-D06 -- Equal contamination sensing and protected candidates

$r$ is an equal contamination sensor rather than subordinate metadata.
Evidence from either coordinate or their joint behavior may establish a pair
event. Expected astronomical/atmospheric response in $r$ is not contamination;
source protection, leakage, Tune, loading, mapping, and source-class evidence
participate in resolution. Hard pair pathology is distinct from diagnostic or
candidate evidence. Weak/uncertain lines, PSD shape, variance, leakage,
coherence, population outliers, Tune-health metrics, and source-overlapping
features remain evidence until the stronger owner-approved predicates pass.

## Closed decision R11-D07 -- Symmetric ordinary action with explicit coordinate exceptions

The common linear operator acts on the paired input after any admitted
coordinate-specific affine baseline corrections. Correction amplitudes and
uncertainties may differ and are never copied between coordinates. A shared
level-shift event has one transition, guards, segment split, and reset, but
separate evidence, step amplitudes, correction availability, and numerical
actions.

An $r$-derived spectral candidate does not automatically remove a band from
$x$. A shared notch is admitted only after the cross-coordinate predicate and
complete $x$ astronomical-transfer, phase, support, covariance, protection,
and false-detection budgets pass; once admitted its ordinary operator is
identical on both coordinates.

The existing $x$ donor transfer is the explicit coordinate-specific recovery
exception. It creates no numerical $r$ donor value. Conditioned $r$ is locally
unavailable over the full causal influence of the $x$-only repair while the
grid remains identical, conditioned $x$ may remain available, and raw-$r$
parentage plus all pair causes persist. A future $r$ recovery requires new
operator identity and authority.

## Canonical numerical and statistical model

On stable segment $I_k$, admitted coordinate-specific affine state is
$\mathbf b_{d,k}=(b^x_{d,k},b^r_{d,k})^{\mathsf T}$ and corrected input is
$\mathbf u_d^\star=\mathbf u_d-\mathbf b_{d,k}$ where available. Canonical
ordinary conditioning is
$\mathbf y_d=(I_2\otimes L_\Pi)\mathbf u_d^\star$. Equality of the two affine
amplitudes is not assumed.

For admitted joint input covariance, fixed-state output covariance on common
available support is
$(I_2\otimes L_\Pi)C_{\rm in}(I_2\otimes L_\Pi)^{\mathsf T}$, retaining
$C'_{xr}=L_\Pi C_{xr}L_\Pi^{\mathsf T}$. Fixed-state cross-coordinate
numerical response remains zero even though $r$ may affect $y_x$ through the
data-dependent causal path from evidence to resolved pair plan. Conditional
response, affine-correction uncertainty, selection uncertainty,
learned-parameter uncertainty, donor-induced $r$ unavailability, and total
derivative availability remain distinct.

## Preserved package boundaries

SCI-CAL continues to calibrate conditioned $x$ only. RTC supplies exact pair
facts and causes; PTC and SCI-VAL own their separately authorized diagnostic,
nuisance-prediction, eligibility, and named-use policies. Existing direct
representative synthesis/replacement exclusions remain intact. No automatic
$r\rightarrow x$ subtraction, cross-coordinate donor, $r$ calibration,
universal eligibility, implementation claim, validation result, science
qualification, or production claim is authorized.

## Required r0.11 outputs

The candidate shall provide revised rationale and engineering PDFs and TeX;
updated shared normative core; stable owner entries; an r0.10-to-r0.11
clause/equation map; exhaustive and rationale crosswalks; cross-package
follow-up; a consistency report; PDF visual-QA/source-identity record; exact
candidate hashes; and an explicit owner-review disposition without claiming
authority freeze.
